subject: Re: MPL kickoff — compute feasibility + budget
body:
Lucia,

Feasibility + resourcing:

Staffing — Umar 40% (TL), Ondrej 40% on reproduction runs, Paloma 30% on the training-stack port, Chiara 40% on data pipelines and eval plumbing.

Compute — confirmed the TPU-only constraint is fine: CIFAR-10-4000 with wrn-28-2 fits our standing cirrus-tpu portfolio quota easily; ImageNet-10% with resnet-50 takes roughly a third of our March quota for ~9 days. Tight but no extra reservation needed.

Budget for the Q3 scaled run — good news: Idris has verbally earmarked $120k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-88 for this project, which covers the internal low-label runs at the scale Umar sketched. I'll get it written into the Q3 plan when the cycle opens; treating it as committed for planning purposes.

So: no blockers on any milestone. Watch item is March cirrus contention if another team bursts.

Santiago
